{{Short description|Mathematics award}}
The '''Ostrowski Prize''' is a [[mathematics]] [[award]] given biennially for outstanding research accomplishments in mathematics and [[numerical analysis]].<ref name=ostrowski>{{cite web|url=https://www.ostrowski.ch/index_e.php?ifile=preis|title=The prize and the prize winners|publisher=Ostrowski Foundation|access-date=2024-11-19}}</ref><ref name=mt>{{cite web|url=https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Honours/Ostrowski/|title=Ostrowski Prize|work=MacTutor History of Mathematics Archive|publisher=University of St Andrews|access-date=2024-05-20}}</ref> [[Alexander Ostrowski]], a longtime professor at the [[University of Basel]], left his estate to the Ostrowski Foundation<ref>Formally, the {{lang|it|Fondazione A.M. Ostrowski per un premio internazionale di alta matematica}} [Foundation A. M. Ostrowski for an international prize in higher mathematics], registered in [[Lugano]], Switzerland</ref> in order to establish the prize.<ref name=mt/>

==Recipients==
* 1989:	[[Louis de Branges]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 1991:	[[Jean Bourgain]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 1993:	[[Miklós Laczkovich]] and [[Marina Ratner]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 1995:	[[Andrew J. Wiles]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 1997: [[Yuri Valentinovich Nesterenko|Yuri V. Nesterenko]] and [[Gilles I. Pisier]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 1999:	[[Alexander A. Beilinson]] and [[Helmut Hofer|Helmut H. Hofer]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 2001:	[[Henryk Iwaniec]], [[Peter Sarnak]], and [[Richard Taylor (mathematician)|Richard L. Taylor]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 2003:	[[Paul Seymour (mathematician)|Paul Seymour]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 2005:	[[Ben Green (mathematician)|Ben Green]] and [[Terence Tao]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 2007: [[Oded Schramm]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 2009: [[Sorin Popa]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/>
* 2011: [[Ib Madsen]], [[David Preiss]], and [[Kannan Soundararajan]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://ostrowski.ch/pdf/preis2011.pdf|title=Ostrowski Prize 2011|year=2011|publisher=Ostrowski Foundation}}</ref>
* 2013: [[Yitang Zhang]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://ostrowski.ch/pdf/preis2013.pdf|title=Citation for Yitang Zhang|year=2013|publisher=Ostrowski Foundation}}</ref>
* 2015: [[Peter Scholze]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://ostrowski.ch/pdf/preis2015.pdf|title=Citation for Peter Scholze|year=2015|publisher=Ostrowski Foundation}}</ref>
* 2017: [[Akshay Venkatesh]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://ostrowski.ch/pdf/preis2017.pdf|title=Citation for Akshay Venkatesh|year=2017|publisher=Ostrowski Foundation}}</ref>
* 2019: [[Assaf Naor]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://ostrowski.ch/pdf/preis2019.pdf|title=Citation for Assaf Naor|year=2019|publisher=Ostrowski Foundation}}</ref>
* 2021: {{ill|Tim Austin (mathematician)|lt=Tim Austin|de|Tim Austin (Mathematiker)}}<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://ostrowski.ch/pdf/preis2021.pdf|title=Citation for Tim Austin|year=2021|publisher=Ostrowski Foundation}}</ref>
* 2023: [[Jacob Tsimerman]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref name=mt/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://ostrowski.ch/pdf/preis2023.pdf|title=Citation for Jacob Tsimerman|year=2023|publisher=Ostrowski Foundation}}</ref>
* 2025: [[Hong Wang]]<ref name=ostrowski/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ostrowski.ch/pdf/preis2025.pdf|title=Citation for Hong Wang|year=2025|publisher=Ostrowski Foundation}}</ref>
